surface: Authenticated Bol connection-management dialog within the Ampere scanner

primary_decision.statement: Choose whether to add a new Bol account or update one existing connection, then connect valid credentials.

items.label: Account connection workflow
items.purpose: Orient the user with existing accounts, capture the selected account credentials, and complete the connection.
items.consequence_of_omission: The user cannot safely choose, configure, and connect the intended account.

placement.justification: Existing identity, fields, and the connect action must remain one coherent decision path.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Account names and Add account remain before the ordered credential fields, which remain before Connect account.

items.label: Credential entry
items.purpose: Capture the account name, client ID, client secret, and management re-authentication.
items.consequence_of_omission: No connection can be created or rotated safely.

placement.justification: Credentials must stay bound to the chosen account action.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Fields remain in name, client ID, client secret, warehouse password order.

items.demotion_reason: The form is an on-demand subordinate state of the primary connection workflow.

items.label: Connect account
items.purpose: Validate against Bol and save the encrypted connection.
items.consequence_of_omission: The user cannot complete the task.

placement.justification: The action depends on all credential fields and must remain adjacent.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Primary save action follows all required fields and precedes secondary cancellation.

items.demotion_reason: The submit control is subordinate to the complete workflow and appears only after fields are available.

items.label: Credential handling note
items.purpose: Set the safety expectation that credentials are not shown again.
items.consequence_of_omission: The user may not understand why current keys cannot be viewed.

placement.justification: It supports trust but must not compete with form completion.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: The note remains concise and never includes secret material or implementation details.

items.demotion_reason: Trust support is secondary to the connect task.

items.label: Close or cancel
items.purpose: Exit management without changing the connection.
items.consequence_of_omission: The user could feel trapped in the management surface.

placement.anchor: dialog top and form action row
placement.justification: Safe exit must be consistently available but visually secondary.

adaptive_behavior.invariant: Close never precedes the primary add/update choice in visual emphasis.

items.demotion_reason: It exits rather than advances the primary task.
